name: Bowerman's Farm Market and U-pick Blueberries

description: A small u-pick farm in Holland, MI, Bowerman's Farm Market and U-pick Blueberries grows Blueberries. The farm is busiest in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
